title: Jobber Receptionist vs Housecall Pro CSR AI
seo_title: Jobber Receptionist vs Housecall Pro CSR AI: Pricing & Business Fit
description: Jobber Receptionist vs Housecall Pro CSR AI: compare plan costs, service prices, booking and web chat, plus Off The Clock’s quoting offer.
intro: Their receptionists belong to different business platforms. Your pricing conversation does not have to be limited to whichever receptionist came with yours.
verdict: Keep the business software you value. Choose Off The Clock for an operator that answers, quotes and books. QuoteDone is the reason to make the receptionist decision separately: the customer’s scope and your prices belong together.

sections: Keep the system. Change the customer outcome.

Jobber Receptionist is a Jobber feature. HCP CSR AI is an HCP add-on. Moving between them can therefore mean a larger software decision than simply choosing a different operator. [[jobber-help]] [[hcp-team]]

Off The Clock is a separate operator offer, not a replacement for jobs, invoices or technician management. Retaining Jobber or HCP and choosing who handles new inquiries are distinct decisions. Actual data connections must match available integrations; no universal native connector is implied.
A configured service price is a starting point
HCP explicitly tells owners to set the available service price and describe what it includes. That supports useful price answers; it should not be dismissed as message taking. [[hcp-practices]]

A flooring project adds another layer: the selected product, installation area and any separate removal scope can all change the price. A fixed service amount is not automatically the calculation for that request.

QuoteDone applies the owner’s pricing to supported job inputs and complete selected scope. When a required quantity is missing, the request retains the details for owner review. It does not trade an accurate exception for an impressive-looking number.
Phone answering and website quoting in one offer

Off The Clock answers business questions, books appointments, transfers callers and follows up. QuoteDone adds the project-pricing conversation, with a dedicated quote widget for visitors who prefer starting online.

Both Jobber and HCP document website communication. The argument for QuoteDone is not that competitors lack chat. It is that a dedicated, owner-priced quote workflow is a different customer action from a general conversation or request form. [[jobber-help]] [[hcp-chat]]
Compare the subscription you would actually add

For an existing Jobber customer, the $29 Receptionist add-on is an incremental cost on eligible plans. For a new customer, the base Jobber subscription is part of the purchase. HCP’s reviewed material does not supply a numerical CSR AI amount. [[jobber-help]] [[jobber-pricing]] [[hcp-team]]

QuoteDone’s separate offer is $279 per month for 1,200 minutes, the operator and website widget. Overage is $0.35 per minute and there is no setup fee. Its case is the additional job-pricing outcome, not a misleading comparison of a whole subscription with a small add-on.
decision: Choose Off The Clock to change what a new customer receives: an answer, a supported job price and a next appointment. Keep your existing business software for the job it already does. QuoteDone handles the pricing conversation you want off your plate.
